name: @ai-ecoverse/hot-glue
description: A macro expander for WebAssembly, written in WebAssembly, operating on WebAssembly

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run -s bootstrap && cp dist/hotglue/*.wasm dist/
scripts.build:native: clang --target=wasm32 -O2 -nostdlib -Wl,--no-entry -Wl,--export=poke -Wl,--export=crc32 examples/native/crc32.c -o examples/native/crc32.wasm && rustc --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --crate-type=cdylib -C opt-level=z -C lto -C strip=symbols -C panic=abort examples/native/fmix.rs -o examples/native/fmix.wasm
scripts.compile: wasmtime --dir src --dir examples --dir . --preload expand=dist/hotglue/expand.wasm --preload as=dist/hotglue/as.wasm dist/hotglue/hotglue.wasm
scripts.fetch:kokoro: mkdir -p models/kokoro/onnx models/kokoro/voices && B=https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX/resolve/main && curl -LsSf -o models/kokoro/config.json $B/config.json && curl -LsSf -o models/kokoro/tokenizer.json $B/tokenizer.json && curl -LsSf -o models/kokoro/tokenizer_config.json $B/tokenizer_config.json && curl -LsSf -o models/kokoro/onnx/model_quantized.onnx $B/onnx/model_quantized.onnx && curl -LsSf -o models/kokoro/voices/af_heart.bin $B/voices/af_heart.bin
scripts.film: npm run -s bootstrap > /dev/null && wasmtime --dir src --dir examples --preload expand=dist/hotglue/expand.wasm --preload as=dist/hotglue/as.wasm dist/hotglue/hotglue.wasm film.hma > dist/film.wasm && node scripts/projector.mjs dist/film.wasm
scripts.build:zig: zig build-exe examples/native/fnv.zig -target wasm32-freestanding -O ReleaseSmall -fno-entry --import-memory --initial-memory=2097152 --global-base=1048576 --stack 8192 --export=fnv1a --export=motto_ptr --export=motto_len -femit-bin=examples/native/fnv.wasm && zig build-exe examples/native/mix.zig -target wasm32-freestanding -O ReleaseSmall -fno-entry --import-memory --initial-memory=2097152 --global-base=1179648 --stack 8192 --export=stamp -femit-bin=examples/native/mix.wasm
scripts.build:braid: npm run -s build:zig && mkdir -p dist && npx tsx src/cli.ts src/as.hma > dist/as.wat && npx tsx src/cli.ts examples/braid.hma > dist/braid-sup.wat && npx tsx src/cli.ts examples/stamp-seam.hma > dist/braid-seam.wat && wasmtime run --invoke run dist/as.wat < dist/braid-sup.wat > dist/braid-sup.wasm && wasmtime run --invoke run dist/as.wat < dist/braid-seam.wat > dist/braid-seam.wasm && wasm-merge dist/braid-sup.wasm env examples/native/fnv.wasm fnv examples/native/mix.wasm mix dist/braid-seam.wasm seam -o dist/braid.wasm && echo 'dist/braid.wasm — run: wasmtime dist/braid.wasm'
